title: Why we killed our free plan (Copy)
name: Why we killed our free plan (Copy)
hook: We gave away the product for two years and it nearly sank us.
transcript: So the question everyone asks us is why we stopped offering a free plan. Honestly, for two years the free tier was our biggest acquisition channel and our biggest cost. About ninety percent of our support tickets came from people who never intended to pay. We ran the numbers in March and the free plan was costing more than our entire marketing budget. So we replaced it with a guided onboarding call and put the money into that instead. Paid conversions went up, support load dropped by half, and nobody on the team misses it.
